newsitem.title: JAPAN: Greenspan arrives for Japan visit.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan arrives for Japan visit.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan arrived in Tokyo on Sunday on a three-day visit for talks with Japanese financial authorities.
Greenspan is scheduled to have meetings with Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita and new Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka on Monday morning.
Later in the day the Fed chairman was due to give a speech at a meeting of the Federation of Bankers Associations of Japan.
Greenspan is visiting Japan at Matsushita's invitation for the first time in four years.
The two central bankers are expected to discuss the foreign exchange situation, interest rate trends and the economic outlook for each other's countries, BOJ officials said.
